subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Christ's Resurrection
description: Learn Christ's Resurrection in one minute.

hook.text: Jesus died on a cross, was buried in a tomb, and rose three days later. The central claim of Christianity.

buildup.text: The empty tomb shocked even the disciples. Mary Magdalene was the first witness—a woman in a patriarchal world.

discovery.text: Christ's resurrection wasn't partial like Osiris's. He returned bodily—eating, speaking, showing wounds.

twist.text: Paul wrote: if Christ didn't rise, faith is worthless. Christianity staked everything on one event happening.

climax.text: Resurrection doesn't just defeat death—it promises believers the same escape. Death loses its finality.

punchline.text: Three days. The whole religion hinges on it.

quiz.question: Who was the first witness to Christ's empty tomb?
